topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of complement
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the complement system and frames the lecture's scope.

topics.label: Introduction to complement principles, nomenclature, and component C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the fundamental principles, naming conventions, and central role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways and threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on the activation threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream processes through which activated complement destroys pathogens and drives inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the mechanisms and regulatory proteins that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct clinical presentations and disease outcomes caused by deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the strategies and specific molecular mechanisms pathogens use to evade complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming topic on the adaptive immune system.
